node.subject: english
node.name: 核对原句与同义改写
node.definition: 对照动作、对象、数量和条件，判断表达是否保留原意。

lesson.definition: 对照动作、对象、数量和条件，判断表达是否保留原意。
lesson.foundation: 词汇变化、主动被动互换、名词与动词转换都可传递同一事实。否定和程度常改变事实。
lesson.principle: 等义必须保留语义角色。Some visitors returned ≠ All visitors returned，即使两句其余部分相同。
lesson.approach: 把原句和选项分别压缩为「谁做什么、在何条件下」。再核对程度及时间顺序。

examples.prompt: The library lends umbrellas at no charge. 可怎样改写？
examples.solution: Visitors can borrow umbrellas for free. lend 与 borrow 视角不同，角色对应。

examples.prompt: Only registered teams can use the hall after dark. 哪个条件不能删？
examples.solution: 登记和天黑后都要保留；这句话并未说白天谁能使用。

lesson.error: 看到原文词多就选。逐项核对逻辑词与动作角色。
lesson.standard: 能说明一项正确改写在语义槽位上的对应，并找出一项改写的变化。
lesson.application: 细节题正确选项常换用表述，干扰项则保留原词但改变范围。

questions.prompt: The room is available at no cost. 等义是？
options: The room is free to use.
questions.explanation: at no cost = free to use。

questions.prompt: Some riders switched to buses. 等义是？
options: Part of the group began using buses.

questions.prompt: The staff postponed the event until July. 等义是？
Visitors must book at least two days ahead. 哪项等义？
options: Book two or more days in advance.

questions.prompt: The neighbor lent Iris a ladder. 等义是？
options: Iris borrowed a ladder from the neighbor.
Iris lent the neighbor a ladder.
The neighbor repaired a ladder for Iris.
questions.explanation: 借出者与借入者角色保持一致。
